scope.statement: The ritual pack uses Padma Purana Uttara Khanda chapter 55. A future owner should preserve the full Mahijit-Lomasha sequence, denied-water former-birth attribution, collective merit transfer, unnamed queen and son-birth claim, and the distinct pavitraka passage with its materials, caste/community roles, hymns, annual obligation and promised results. These remain source facts, not fertility, caste, animal-contact or universal household instructions.
